description: Data Supplement to: 'A 3 million year index for North African humidity/aridity and the implication of potential pan-African Humid periods'; Note: the dust proxy is from Larrasoaña et al. (2003), rescaled to our chronology. It is based on magnetic measurements (IRM@0.9 AF 120mT (A/m)) reflecting hematite variations, which (at this site) reflect aeolian dust fluxes.
